comment: do.c dodown() 'You are held back by your pet!' (1252-1254): a Tourist leashes his kitten with a wished cursed leash, teleports (^T) beside the corner down staircase, puts the kitten to sleep with a wand of sleep two squares from the stairs, steps onto them and fills the three free neighbours with a counted ^G of brown molds. On '>', mnexto() cannot put the kitten next to him, and the cursed leash holds him back (apply.c mleashed_next2u()).
